evidence.ref: E002 (Kind: curated_research): selected low-cardinality user profile domains added on top of hour, train-derived user exposure-gap buckets, and censored watch-time auxiliary training
Trusted runtime-backend contract: exact_parent_config.features=["hour","user_gap"] and feature_api supports user_core as seven static pre-impression user profile fields
Categorical vocabularies must be fitted on train only and unseen evaluation values map to UNK

evidence_adaptation.implementation_mapping: Primary block features: the selected_user_profile registry operator adds seven user-profile categorical arrays to each Xs[split], converts them to train-fitted globally offset categorical IDs, updates dimension, and leaves SO.train to consume Xs[train][train_idx] through the existing FM.
evidence_adaptation.protocol_caveat: The cited measurements are treated only as evidence for the incremental representation mechanism; improvement must be established on the fixed official split and trusted primary metric, and no reported score is assumed to transfer.
evidence_adaptation.source_mechanism: Add selected low-cardinality static user profile domains after hour and strictly-earlier user exposure-gap fields so FM embeddings cross those user attributes with candidate item and context fields.

expected_observation: feature_dim will increase and predictions will differ from w001 for every seed; if the hypothesis is true, trusted validation will show a positive paired primary delta and positive marginal contribution when substituted for w001 in the active portfolio.

experiment_contract.claim: The experiment tests whether seven selected legal static user-profile fields improve ranking through FM interactions with each candidate and context.
experiment_contract.expected_observable: The feature dimension and prediction hashes must change relative to w001, with row-varying effects induced by user-profile and candidate-field interactions.
experiment_contract.falsification_condition: The claim is falsified if the connected operator yields no positive trusted validation-primary or marginal-portfolio delta across the fixed seeds; byte-identical predictions or unchanged feature_dim instead invalidate the implementation.
forbidden_shortcuts: Using any post-exposure feedback as a profile feature
Adding a per-user constant that cannot change within-user ranking
Replacing the catalog operator with an ad hoc custom implementation
Changing optimizer or auxiliary-loss hyperparameters in the same experiment
required_components: Registry-owned addition of all seven selected pre-impression user-profile fields
Train-only vocabulary fitting with one UNK slot for unseen values
Globally offset categorical IDs appended to Xs for every split
Reuse of the existing FM and bpr_censored_watch training path

fallback: Rollback the operator and retain the exact w001 feature representation.
hypothesis: Adding the seven selected static user-profile fields to w001 will improve official validation primary and its marginal portfolio contribution because their FM crosses create candidate-dependent personalization that is absent from the current hour+user-gap feature configuration.
implementation_plan: Apply the registry-owned selected_user_profile operator. In the features block, extend the current hour and strictly-earlier user-gap representation with the seven low-cardinality static pre-impression user profile fields. The trusted operator maps train-fitted categorical vocabularies to globally offset FM IDs and uses UNK for unseen evaluation values; the resulting fields interact with candidate video, author, duration bucket, hour, and user-gap fields through the existing FM.
justification: The proposed fields are legal at inference and can alter ordering within a user through interactions with candidate-item fields. The evidence studies the same incremental placement—on top of hour, exposure gap, and the watch-time auxiliary mechanism—making it more directly applicable than broad profile expansion or a new architecture family.
observation: The exact parent configuration contains only features ["hour","user_gap"] beyond its base representation, while the applicable catalog operator explicitly adds seven static pre-impression user fields. E002 reports that selected user-profile domains produced an incremental effect when added after hour, user-gap, and censored-watch auxiliary training.

research_evidence.query: Which legal context and side-information fields complement the FM?
research_evidence.reason: Broad side-feature additions can add noise; legal temporal context needs an explicit availability rule.
research_evidence.summary: Prioritize low-cardinality hour and train-derived user exposure-gap buckets before broad profile expansion. Compute all quantile edges from train only. The hour+user_gap BPR configuration reached five-seed official-validation primary 0.604430330 ± 0.000459158; adding the censored watch-time auxiliary target reached 0.604607224 ± 0.000168363. Adding selected user profile domains on top reached 0.604821956 ± 0.000355822, a smaller incremental effect. The legal hour+gap+aux configuration also led the inspected random-exposure set at unbiased primary 0.378085981 ± 0.003012055. Any history feature must use train feedback or exposure-only information available at prediction time; evaluation-period long_view/play-time feedback is forbidden.

risk: Sparse profile-item crosses may overfit users or categories that drift after the train period.
The new member may be highly rank-correlated with w001 and therefore add little portfolio value.
UNK-heavy evaluation fields could reduce the effective representation gain.
